items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: Because they had Aretha, they had Wilson Pickett, they had the whole Memphis thing with Otis and Sam & Dave and you know, that crew.

ctx.x: And that was like the heyday of Atlantic R&B. Because they had Aretha, they had Wilson Pickett, they had the whole Memphis thing with Otis and Sam & Dave and you know, that crew. So the place was insane.
You had a few years, your son described —
